Summarizing a Text in German: B1 Phrase Practice

Give a short account of a text's topic and main points in German. Practise handelt von and betont with translated models and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A short text summary identifies the topic and selects central points: Der Text handelt von … . Im Mittelpunkt steht … names the focus, while Die Autorin betont, dass … attributes emphasis to the author. A summary reports the text rather than automatically agreeing with its claims.

Common mistake to avoid

Handeln von takes von plus dative for the topic. Distinguish the author's statement from your own opinion when summarizing.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Der Text handelt von veränderten Lesegewohnheiten.The text is about changing reading habits.
Worked example 2Im Mittelpunkt steht die Nutzung öffentlicher Bibliotheken.The focus is on the use of public libraries.
Worked example 3Die Autorin betont, dass persönliche Begegnungen wichtig bleiben.The author emphasises that face-to-face encounters remain important.
Worked example 4Die Kernaussage lässt sich in einem Satz zusammenfassen.The main point can be summarised in one sentence.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the summary frame using the verb, noun or infinitive specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: betont · handelt · Mittelpunkt · zusammenfassen

Question 1. Der Artikel ___ von einem Nachbarschaftsprojekt. (handeln)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: handelt

Handelt von introduces what the article is about.

Question 2. Im ___ steht die Zusammenarbeit im Viertel. (centre, in this focus phrase)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Mittelpunkt

Im Mittelpunkt steht identifies the central focus.

Question 3. Der Autor ___ die Bedeutung offener Treffpunkte. (emphasises)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: betont

Betont attributes the emphasis to the author.

Question 4. Die wichtigsten Punkte kann man kurz ___. (summarise)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: zusammenfassen

Zusammenfassen is the infinitive after kann.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
